theories.title: Retirement and elder financial system collapsing
theories.summary: Multiple financial outlets signal systemic stress in retirement planning: outdated life expectancy assumptions sabotaging portfolios, Americans withdrawing from retirement accounts early, elderly forced to relocate for financial survival, and widespread confusion about Medicare and advisor conflicts of interest. The narrative frames this as a demographic-economic time bomb where traditional retirement math no longer works.
theories.why_signal: Retirement concerns hit top marketwatch posts 5 consecutive times with high engagement, amplified by working-class economic analysis across income/wealth divide; signals structural inequality deepening.

theories.title: Iran war deepening with oil chokepoint control contested
theories.summary: Six-month Iran war anniversary reveals diverging official narratives: Bloomberg claims high oil flows through Hormuz while Iran threatens closure; US claims military gaining upper hand against Iranian blockade; diesel stress rising globally; trade war with Canada cutting oil exports. The claim: control of global energy chokepoints is now the war's real battlefield.
theories.why_signal: All financial, energy, and geopolitical communities reporting same six-month milestone; oil price impacts global commodity markets in real-time; directly continues yesterday's military munitions/Iran crisis thread.

breaking_news.why_notable: New institutional creation signals Trump's commitment to space industry militarization and personnel pipeline; follows Artemis program politicization.

breaking_news.why_notable: Legal path to conviction reversal closes; signals New York conviction likely stands through 2026 midterms and beyond.

breaking_news.title: U.S. economy created fewer new jobs in 2025-2026, it turns out. Just how bad was it?
